protocol_name: Broth Microdilution and Cytotoxicity Assay Serial Dilution

paper.title: Piper betle Extracts and Multiple Drug Resistant Bacteria
paper.assay_type: Broth microdilution MIC/MBC and MTT cytotoxicity assay

stock_source.liquid: Piper betle plant extract stock solution

gates.prompt: Inspect plate, add bacterial inoculum or cell suspension to the respective assays, and proceed to incubation.

off_deck: Plant material extraction (ethanol, methanol, supercritical CO2)
Bacterial culture preparation and McFarland adjustment
Incubation of microdilution trays (35 C for 16-20 hours)
Sub-culturing for MBC on sheep BAP
MTT assay incubation and absorbance reading on microplate reader
open_clarifications: The paper specifies a two-fold serial dilution starting from 100 mg/ml down to 2.44 ug/ml for the antimicrobial broth microdilution assay, and specific concentrations (100 ug/ml down to 0.78 ug/ml) for the MTT assay. Standard 8-step two-fold serial dilution fractions are modeled here.
